description: Feature backlog - Product Owner owns priority

items.title: Simplify: make maturity mandatory, refine automatic, worktree-only, cut diagnose, inline notifications
items.intent: Remove toggles for core behaviors — maturity protocol is always on (delete --quick flag and MATURITY_ENABLED config), spec refinement is automatic on final failure (delete --refine flag), worktree isolation is the only mode (delete stash path and ISOLATION_MODE config), diagnose command deleted (users check logs), notification wrappers inlined
steps: Remove --quick flag, MATURITY_ENABLED config, AISHORE_MATURITY env var — maturity protocol always runs
Remove --refine flag, REFINE_ON_EXHAUST config, AISHORE_REFINE env var — always refine before final failure
Remove stash isolation path: delete restore_stash, stash-related code in setup_sprint_environment — worktree is the only mode
Remove ISOLATION_MODE config and AISHORE_ISOLATION env var
Delete cmd-diagnose.sh module and diagnose dispatch entry
Inline send_notification: replace wrapper with direct conditional at call sites, simplify send_session_notification to just terminal bell plus log message
Run smoke test and drift check
acceptanceCriteria: Worktree is created for every sprint (no stash path)
Spec refinement runs automatically when retries exhausted
